title: Effortless Pork Skillet
description: A simple and delicious pork skillet recipe with creamy sauce, inspired by Russian cuisine.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the pork shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually pour in the heavy cream, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Return the pork shoulder to the skillet and spoon some of the creamy sauce over the top.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
